<!--
Geographic distribution by country
The map of distribution has moved to report_main.Rmd ("Mapped distribution"
section) so it is always shown.  This child only renders the country table
when params$countries is supplied; otherwise it produces nothing — the
consolidated "not requested" sentence in report_main.Rmd covers the
explanation.
-->


```{r countries_text, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (is.null(params$countries)) {
  country_text <- ""
} else {
  country_text <- paste0(
    "From the most recent ", max(params$years),
    " classification, the ecosystem is found in the following countries: ",
    paste(params$countries$Country, collapse = ", "),
    ". The area and percentage of the ecosystem within each country as ",
    "measured in ", max(params$years), " is summarised in the table below:"
  )
}
```

`r country_text`

```{r coo, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = !is.null(params$countries), results='asis'}
coo_df <- params$countries
title_text <- "Ecosystem occurrence at a country level"

# display the table
if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  htmltools::tagList(
    # centered Title
    htmltools::div(
      style = "text-align:center; font-weight:bold; font-size:18px; margin-bottom:10px;", title_text),
    DT::datatable(coo_df, rownames = F,
                  escape  = FALSE,
                  options = list(
                    paging = FALSE,
                    searching = FALSE,
                    info = FALSE,
                    dom = 't',
                    autoWidth = TRUE,
                    scrollX = FALSE)) %>%
      DT::formatStyle(columns = c(1:ncol(coo_df)), fontSize = '100%')
  )
} else {
  # flextable
 # PDF/Word: styled flextable
  set_flextable_defaults(theme_fun = theme_vanilla, background.color = "transparent")
  
  coo_tab <- flextable(coo_df) |>
    style_pdf_table(caption_text = title_text)
  
  coo_tab <- flextable(coo_df) |>
  set_caption(
      caption = flextable::as_paragraph(flextable::as_b(title_text)),
      align_with_table = FALSE) |>   # let caption span page width, not just table
  # set_header_labels(
  #       `% of Ecosystem`       = "Ecosystem occurrence\n(%)",
  #      `% of Country coverage`       = "Country\ncoverage\n(%)",
  # ) |>
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
  align(align = "left", part = "all") |>  # Center header text
  valign(valign = "center", part = "all")# |> # Vertically center
  
  coo_tab
}
```
